title: Reject Guo forcing with mixture equilibrium velocity
statement: collide_sc_two_component_27 must raise ValueError when use_guo=True and u_eq='mixture'; documented valid configurations must remain accepted.
rationale: The Guo branch applies a force correction in addition to the per-component equilibrium velocity shift. The current implementation documents that this combination breaks the intended mixture momentum-exchange identity.

validator.version: pinned by the TensorLBM project environment

fixtures.positive: tests/test_mcmp_mixture_3d.py::test_t5_mixture_self_discrimination asserts ValueError for use_guo=True with u_eq='mixture' for both D3Q19 and D3Q27.
fixtures.negative: The same test checks invalid u_eq rejection; test_t0_default_path_bitwise_identical_to_explicit_self covers valid Guo forcing with the default/self convention, and mixture tests exercise the velocity-shift path.

acceptance.invalid_configuration: raises ValueError with a message explaining that mixture equilibrium requires use_guo=False
acceptance.valid_configuration: default/self + Guo and mixture + velocity-shift continue to run without changing legacy default behavior

remediation: Use u_eq='self' when use_guo=True, or use the velocity-shift forcing (use_guo=False) for u_eq='mixture'. Revisit the rule only alongside a derivation and tests that establish a correct alternative formulation.
